name: Mandalay Kitchen
neighborhoodOrCity: Frogtown, St. Paul (383 University Ave. W.)
whatItIs: Knyaw (Karen), Burmese and Thai restaurant opened November 2023 by chef Chris Tunbaw; mohinga, tea leaf salad, noodle salads. Karen-owned; also listed on the Karen page.
evidence: Own site, checked Oct. 31, 2026, says 'We're open!' with a limited-menu notice and a current menu and phone number. Racket (Jan. 12, 2024) gives the address and opening.

name: Karenni Grocery Store
whatItIs: 20,000-square-foot Karenni-owned grocery with fruit, Southeast Asian ingredients, wild boar, betel nuts and leaves, and Karen and Karenni clothing; described by its owners as the Twin Cities' first Karenni grocery.
evidence: Sahan Journal, March 6, 2025, reports the grand opening. No own site or 2026 dated sign of operation was found.

name: Loikaw21
whatItIs: Karenni store that opened during the pandemic, named by the Maplewood grocery owners as the only other Karenni market they knew of in Minnesota.
evidence: Mentioned in Sahan Journal, March 6, 2025. No own site or dated current listing was opened.

name: Sitagu Dhamma Vihara (Theravada Dhamma Society of Minnesota)
whatItIs: Burmese Theravada Buddhist temple and monastery with a Shwedagon Pagoda replica; community festivals, Burmese language and culture classes, meditation. Nonprofit, not a business; listed because it is the main Bamar gathering place found.
evidence: Own site lists address, daily schedule and contact email, but pages are undated; latest years mentioned are 2022 and 2023. No 2025 or 2026 dated item found.

name: Karen Organization of Minnesota (KOM)
whatItIs: Social service agency founded in 2008 by refugees from Burma; says it serves all ethnic groups from Burma, including Karenni, Mon and Chin; staff speak Burmese and Karenni among other languages.
evidence: Own site lists 2026 events (DeeKu Festival 2026, KOM 2026 Awards) and a Nov. 26, 2025 statement.
